arStrings.szText: Take your {c_highlight}Fresh Meat{/c} to Kael Rills in Gea Kul to exchange for {c_highlight}Bloodied Items{/c}.

Playing as the Butcher is an excellent source of {c_highlight}Fresh Meat{/c}. Transforming into the Butcher is available in {c_highlight}Helltide{/c}, {c_highlight}Slaughterhouses{/c}, as well as the {c_highlight}Fields of Hatred (PvP){/c} zones.

{c_highlight}Bloodied Items{/c} have special affixes that interact with {c_highlight}Killstreaks{/c}. They come in three categories: {c_highlight}Rampage{/c}, {c_highlight}Feast{/c}, and {c_highlight}Hunger{/c}.
{c_highlight}Rampage{/c} affixes on {c_highlight}Bloodied Items{/c} grow stronger as your {c_highlight}Killstreak{/c} tier increases.
{c_highlight}Feast{/c} affixes on {c_highlight}Bloodied Items{/c} trigger potent effects at regular intervals during a {c_highlight}Killstreak{/c}.
As you progress through {c_highlight}Season Ranks{/c}, be sure to periodically check in the {c_highlight}Season{/c} tab for new rewards.
Uncertain on what to do next? Check the {c_highlight}Season{/c} tab for a suite of bonus objectives to pursue on your journeys through Sanctuary.
Completing {c_highlight}Capstone Dungeons{/c} grants significant rewards, such as powerful gear, skill points, paragon points, cosmetics, and more.
{c_highlight}Capstone Dungeons{/c} are a fixed difficulty level. Having trouble defeating them? Level up and return. Monsters will not level with you.
Progress through {c_highlight}Season Ranks{/c} to unlock new rewards. Complete {c_highlight}Capstone Dungeons{/c} to unlock new tiers of Season Ranks.
{c_highlight}Hunger{/c} affixes on {c_highlight}Bloodied Items{/c} cause {c_highlight}Killstreaks{/c} to yield bonus rewards.
Your progression earned through {c_highlight}Season Ranks{/c} apply to both the softcore and hardcore seasonal realms.

During the Season of Slaughter, {c_highlight}Bloodmarking{/c} is disabled in the Fields of Hatred. However, you can become the Butcher at the end of the {c_highlight}Ceremony of Slaughter{/c} and hunt down other players for their {c_highlight}Fresh Meat{/c}.

{c_highlight}Bloodied Lair Boss Sigils{/c}, {c_highlight}Bloodied Nightmare Sigils{/c}, and {c_highlight}Bloodied Infernal Hordes Compasses{/c} open significantly harder challenges in {c_highlight}Torment{/c} difficulty tiers.
